title: Astronomers Have Completed the Largest Map of Space. Yes, You Can Play With It.
summary: Data from the first three years of DESI’s survey—combined with observations of supernovae and the pervasive radiation leftover from the Big Bang —have hinted that dark energy may not be a constant force but is gradually weakening over time.
